BITS OF HISTORY (MARCH 26)
2019-03-27T00:00:00+06:00 | The Daily Star
https://www.thedailystar.net/world/news/bits-history-march-26-1720873

1979: In a ceremony at the White House, President Sadat of Egypt and Prime Minister Begin of Israel signed a peace treaty ending 30 years of war between the two countries. 2002: Up to 1,000 people were killed when a series of quakes struck Baghlan Province in Afghanistan.
